content: We next visualize the detected events based on the discriminative features learned by the trained INLINEFORM0 network in AEM. The t-SNE BIBREF16 visualization results on the datasets are shown in Figure FIGREF19 . For clarity, each subplot is plotted on a subset of the dataset containing ten randomly selected events. It can be observed that documents describing the same event have been grouped into the same cluster.
